description: The bar chart illustrates sample counts for four essay genres under two conditions labeled “Open” and “Cons.” The horizontal axis contains the genre categories, ordered left to right as Argumentative, Narrative, Descriptive, and Expository, while the vertical axis is labeled “Sample Count” and uses a linear numeric scale ranging from 0 to about 130 with regularly spaced tick marks at 20-unit intervals. For each genre, two adjacent bars are shown: a light blue bar for Open and a light pink bar for Cons., with numeric value labels above each bar. In Argumentative, the Open bar is 79 and the Cons. bar is 122; in Narrative, Open is 80 and Cons. is 87; in Descriptive, Open is 68 and Cons. is 100; and in Expository, Open is 62 and Cons. is 130. The bars are grouped by genre (side-by-side within each category) rather than stacked, and no additional visual emphasis such as outlines or annotations beyond the value labels is present; the categories are not displayed as sorted by bar height.
